text.en: Pet parents consistently express delight with styling quality, describing dogs that leave groomed to perfection, smelling fantastic, and looking clean and tidy. Multiple reviewers mention the best cuts their dogs have ever had, from fluffy Pomeranians to smooth-coated breeds.

Clients highlight the calm and reassuring care given to pets of all temperaments, including nervous rescue dogs, excitable dachshunds, and working guide dogs. Reviewers appreciate that the team takes extra time to soothe anxious animals so that grooming remains a positive experience.

Owner Giedre and her team receive widespread praise for their warmth, approachable manner, and meticulous attention to canine comfort. Longstanding clients highlight consistent friendliness across multiple years of visits, noting that staff always listen attentively to styling requests.

q.en: Can nervous or easily stressed dogs be groomed here?

a.en: Yes, reviewers frequently praise the team for their patient, calming approach with timid, excitable, and anxious pets.

q.en: Are working animals like guide dogs welcomed at the spa?

a.en: Yes, clients highlight that assistance animals and guide dogs receive welcoming, respectful care during their grooming sessions.

q.en: Does the salon offer standalone nail trimming services?

a.en: Reviewers note quick and gentle nail clipping visits, commending the team for their kindness with small dogs like chihuahuas.

q.en: Is advance booking required for Plush Puppy Spa?

a.en: Long-term clients mention that the salon can be fully booked, so booking appointments well in advance is recommended.
